# Configuration parameters (generated)

<!-- Generated by `uv run ccil config docs`; edit src/ccil/config/params.py, not this file. -->

Resolve and validate a configuration; raise ConfigError listing every problem.

Values in files are YAML; numbers with units may be written `"<n> <unit>"` with exactly the declared unit. Command-line values are parsed by type: booleans accept only `true` or `false`; lists accept `a,b` or `[a, b]`; nullable values accept `null`.

`declared` parameters are validated and documented now and consumed by the milestone shown.

## run

| Key | Type | Default | Units | Domain | Status | Description | Rationale | Replaces |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `run.seed` | int | `42` | - | [0, inf] | implemented | Seed for every random choice in the run, including the trajectory split. | Legacy default seed in every config. | `seed` |
| `run.output_dir` | path | `"runs"` | - | - | implemented | Directory under which run directories are created. | Replaces output.location; run directories are named by run ID. | `output.location` |
| `run.overwrite` | bool | `false` | - | - | implemented | Replace an existing run directory with the same run ID. | Legacy scripts always overwrote; the core refuses unless asked. | `overwrite` |

## transition_model

| Key | Type | Default | Units | Domain | Status | Description | Rationale | Replaces |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `transition_model.trainer_version` | choice | `"1"` | - | `1`, `2` | implemented | How mlp transition models are fitted (#110). | 1 fits each model with its own loop (MLPTransitionModel.fit); 2 with the batched engine (models/mlp_batched.py), which study runners use to fit many seeds together. Same protocol, not bit-compatible, so the version is part of the stage identity. | - |
| `transition_model.fit_episodes` | choice | `"all"` | - | `all`, `train` | implemented | Episodes the label model is fitted on. | all (legacy) fits it on every episode, and a separate evaluation model on the train split is scored on the held-out episodes; train fits the label model on the train split only, so held-out episodes influence no training label (a clean holdout), and that model is the one scored. | - |
| `transition_model.kind` | choice | `"mlp"` | - | `linear`, `mlp` | implemented | Transition-model family: linear (least squares) or mlp. | Legacy code used an MLP (WorldModel), ported in #21; mlp needs the prlccil[torch] extra (Python 3.11+). | - |
| `transition_model.direction` | choice | `"forward"` | - | `forward`, `backward` | implemented | Fit s_{t+1} from (s_t, a_t), or s_t from (s_{t+1}, a_t). | Legacy dynamics.backward, absent (forward) in every config. | `dynamics.backward` |
| `transition_model.checkpoint` | path | `null` | - | - | implemented | A transition-model checkpoint to load instead of fitting one: an externally supplied model (a checkpoint transition.fit wrote). Its kind, representation, dimensions, direction and action period must match the run's, or loading fails before any label is generated; null fits the model. | New (#170); the legacy code always fitted. | - |
| `transition_model.structure` | choice | `"none"` | - | `none`, `history_shift` | implemented | Known structure of the state the transition model need not learn: none, or history_shift, for a state whose every representation part is history_steps equal contiguous slots, oldest first (e.g. [x_{t-1}, x_t]). history_shift predicts the older slots' next values exactly as the shift they are (slot i becomes slot i + 1) and fits the MLP only to the newest slot's next value; its Jacobian is assembled from the exact shift and the network's. | New (#30): a generic residual MLP relearns the shift with an error larger than its error on the actual dynamics, and a preimage label whose history is not a shift of its target's is not a transition the system can make. mlp, trainer_version 1, forward, identity representation, generation.method noisy_action_fe, generation.recovery_steps 1 and no certificate profile or calibration only. | - |
| `transition_model.history_steps` | int | `null` | - | [2, inf] | implemented | Slots per representation part under transition_model.structure history_shift (2 for [x_{t-1}, x_t]). | New (#30); required by history_shift, unused otherwise. | - |
| `transition_model.lipschitz_type` | choice | `null` | - | `none`, `spectral_normalization`, `slack`, `spectral_normalization_slack`, `soft_sampling`, `soft_sampling_slack`, `soft_jac` | implemented | Lipschitz regularization of the transition model. | Task-specific in legacy configs. | `dynamics.lipschitz_type` |
| `transition_model.lipschitz_constraint` | float | `null` | - | (0.0, inf] | implemented | Target Lipschitz bound. | Task-specific (1.0-4.0) in legacy configs. | `dynamics.lipschitz_constraint` |
| `transition_model.lipschitz_coordinates` | choice | `"model_normalized"` | - | `raw`, `model_normalized` | implemented | Coordinates of the sampled Lipschitz penalties (soft_sampling, soft_sampling_slack): the ratio hinged at lipschitz_constraint. | model_normalized (#125) perturbs the model's normalized inputs and compares its normalized residuals: a dimensionless ratio in the space the network is optimized in, invariant (up to the normalization's 1e-8 and ReLU kinks) under a consistent per-coordinate rescaling of states, actions and residuals. raw (#21) uses raw residuals over raw perturbations, so the constant depends on the units and the timestep (on continuous Pendulum it never binds at 2). Legacy mixed the two. The penalty is a training regularizer, never a certified bound. soft_jac supports raw only. Configurations before config_version 2 resolve to raw. | - |
| `transition_model.soft_penalty_weight` | float | `null` | - | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Weight of the soft Lipschitz penalty. | Task-specific in legacy configs. | `dynamics.soft_lipschitz_penalty_weight` |
| `transition_model.soft_sampling_eps` | float | `0.0003` | normalized input units (model_normalized) or raw state and action units (raw) | (0.0, inf] | implemented | Perturbation radius for sampled Lipschitz estimates. | Same value in every legacy config. Under model_normalized it is a radius in the model's normalized input space; under raw it perturbs raw state and action coordinates together. | `dynamics.soft_lipschitz_sampling_eps` |
| `transition_model.soft_samples` | int | `5` | - | [1, inf] | declared (M3 (#21)) | Samples per point for sampled Lipschitz estimates. | Same value in every legacy config. | `dynamics.soft_lipschitz_n_samples` |
| `transition_model.slack_weight` | float | `1.0` | - | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Weight of the slack penalty. | Legacy code default when slack_weight is absent. | `dynamics.slack_weight` |
| `transition_model.learning_rate` | float | `0.001` | - | (0.0, inf] | implemented | Adam learning rate. | Same value in every legacy config. | `dynamics.lr` |
| `transition_model.weight_decay` | float | `1e-05` | - | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Adam weight decay. | Same value in every legacy config. | `dynamics.weight_decay` |
| `transition_model.hidden_layers` | ints | `null` | - | [1, inf] | implemented | Hidden layer widths. | Task-specific in legacy configs. | `dynamics.layers` |
| `transition_model.activation` | choice | `"relu"` | - | `relu`, `tanh` | implemented | Hidden activation. | Same value in every legacy config. | `dynamics.activation` |
| `transition_model.epochs` | int | `null` | - | [1, inf] | implemented | Training epochs. | Task-specific in legacy configs. | `dynamics.train_epochs` |
| `transition_model.batch_size` | int | `null` | - | [1, inf] | implemented | Minibatch size. | Task-specific in legacy configs. | `dynamics.batch_size` |

## certificate

| Key | Type | Default | Units | Domain | Status | Description | Rationale | Replaces |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `certificate.profile` | choice | `null` | - | `continuity`, `backtrack`, `disturbed_action`, `backtrack_paper_proxy`, `disturbed_action_paper_proxy`, `legacy_label_filtering` | implemented | Certify the labels with this profile (labels.certify); null skips it. | Replaces the label-filtering estimate (#88). Bound profiles: continuity, backtrack, disturbed_action. Score profiles: backtrack_paper_proxy, disturbed_action_paper_proxy, legacy_label_filtering. | - |
| `certificate.reference_dynamics` | path | `null` | - | - | implemented | ccil.reference-dynamics file of the true dynamics: the source of a bound profile's analytic constants and demonstration residuals, or of the observed errors calibration.level calibrates a score profile against. | Known only for analytic systems; without it the true constants and the demonstration residual bound are declared, and the certificate is conditional. | - |
| `certificate.true_state_lipschitz` | float | `null` | error per scaled state | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Declared state Lipschitz constant K_z of the true dynamics. | An assumption, recorded as such (conditional); used without certificate.reference_dynamics. | - |
| `certificate.true_action_lipschitz` | float | `null` | error per scaled action | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Declared action Lipschitz constant K_a of the true dynamics. | An assumption, recorded as such (conditional); used without certificate.reference_dynamics. | - |
| `certificate.learned_lipschitz_source` | choice | `"model"` | - | `model`, `declared` | implemented | Source of the learned state constant K_hat_z. | model computes it from the frozen checkpoint (verified for linear models, conditional for MLPs); declared uses certificate.learned_state_lipschitz. | - |
| `certificate.learned_state_lipschitz` | float | `null` | error per scaled state | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Declared state Lipschitz constant K_hat_z of the model. | Used when certificate.learned_lipschitz_source is declared. | - |
| `certificate.discrepancy_state_lipschitz` | float | `null` | error per scaled state | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Declared state constant C_z of the continuity profile (variation of f - f_hat). | Used by continuity unless the reference dynamics and a linear model give it exactly. | - |
| `certificate.discrepancy_action_lipschitz` | float | `null` | error per scaled action | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Declared action constant C_a of the continuity profile (variation of f - f_hat). | Used by continuity unless the reference dynamics and a linear model give it exactly. | - |
| `certificate.demonstration_residual_bound` | float | `null` | scaled state | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Declared bound on every demonstration residual ||T(z_t, a_t) - z_{t+1}||. | Bound profiles add the residual once; without certificate.reference_dynamics it must be declared. | - |
| `certificate.neighborhood_state` | float | `null` | scaled state | (0.0, inf] | implemented | Labels farther than this from their anchor state are unsupported. | Null: the constants are global. | - |
| `certificate.neighborhood_action` | float | `null` | scaled action | (0.0, inf] | implemented | Labels farther than this from their anchor action are unsupported. | Null: the constants are global; backtrack keeps the anchor's action and takes none. | - |

## curate

| Key | Type | Default | Units | Domain | Status | Description | Rationale | Replaces |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `curate.tolerance` | float | `null` | scaled state | (0.0, inf] | implemented | Select labels whose certificate error is at most this. | Admission follows the profile: a bound profile admits only upper bounds, a score profile admits empirical scores and never presents them as bounds. Null admits every supported row. Legacy aug.max_label_err. | `aug.max_label_err` |
| `curate.quantile` | float | `null` | - | (0.0, 1.0] | implemented | Select admitted, accepted labels whose error is at most this quantile of the population's. | A data budget; it never changes acceptance or classification. Legacy aug.label_err_quantile (0.3 in the label-filtering pendulum configs). | `aug.label_err_quantile` |
| `curate.population` | choice | `"admitted"` | - | `admitted`, `produced` | implemented | Rows the selection quantile is taken over. | admitted: accepted, admissible rows. produced: every supported row a legacy run would have generated, independently of the tolerance and support radius, as the label-filtering branch did; migrated legacy configurations use it. | - |

## diagnose

| Key | Type | Default | Units | Domain | Status | Description | Rationale | Replaces |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `diagnose.probe_transitions` | int | `256` | - | [1, inf] | implemented | Training transitions in the fixed diagnosis probe. | Stratified by episode under this budget: every episode when there are at most this many, otherwise this many evenly spaced episodes; the diagnosis records the coverage. | - |
| `diagnose.tau_quantile` | float | `0.95` | - | (0.0, 1.0] | implemented | Quantile of held-out-to-training nearest demonstration distances that defines tau_demo. | The Pendulum studies' definition of the demonstrations' own spacing. | - |
| `diagnose.tau_sample` | int | `2048` | - | [1, inf] | implemented | Held-out states, evenly spaced, used to estimate tau_demo. | Bounds tau_demo to linear work in the training set; the diagnosis records the sample. | - |
| `diagnose.label_quantile` | float | `0.9` | - | (0.0, 1.0] | implemented | Quantile of the accepted probe labels' d_source and d_demo used by the displacement and novelty gates. | Decided 2026-11-03 (#167): what most labels attain, not the extreme one. | - |
| `diagnose.min_displacement` | float | `1.0` | - | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Admit only if labels move at least this many tau_demo from their sources. | Displacement, not novelty: a label can move far and land beside another demonstration. | - |
| `diagnose.min_novelty` | float | `1.0` | - | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Admit only if labels lie at least this many tau_demo from the nearest training demonstration state. | Below 1, the dataset already covers the states the labels reach (#167, #171). | - |
| `diagnose.fit_quantile` | float | `0.95` | - | (0.0, 1.0] | implemented | Quantile of the held-out one-step model error used by the fit gate. | Decided 2026-11-03 (#167). | - |
| `diagnose.fit_ratio` | float | `0.5` | - | (0.0, inf] | implemented | Admit only if the held-out model error is at most this fraction of the median accepted d_source. | Decided 2026-11-03 (#167): the model must fit where it has data. Necessary, never sufficient. | - |
| `diagnose.min_yield` | float | `0.01` | - | [0.0, 1.0] | implemented | Admit only if at least this fraction of the probe labels is accepted. | Decided 2026-11-03 (#167): a generator whose labels are nearly all rejected is degenerate. | - |

## calibration

| Key | Type | Default | Units | Domain | Status | Description | Rationale | Replaces |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `calibration.level` | float | `null` | - | (0.0, 1.0) | implemented | Calibrate the score profile's errors at this coverage level (labels.calibrate); null skips it. | Reference-assisted: one bound, conformal over the held-out episodes, on the largest observed error under certificate.reference_dynamics of each episode's empirical rows. It needs generation.evidence_mode reference_assisted, a score profile, held-out episodes (at least level / (1 - level) of them for a bound), and transition_model.fit_episodes all, so the labels do not depend on the split. Curation then admits the training episodes' empirical rows as bounds at this level (docs/certificates.md). | - |

## Cross-field rules

- `pca_dim`: `representation.kind`, `representation.dim`
- `history_shift`: `transition_model.structure`, `transition_model.history_steps`, `transition_model.kind`, `transition_model.trainer_version`, `transition_model.direction`, `representation.kind`, `generation.method`, `generation.recovery_steps`, `certificate.profile`, `calibration.level`
- `modality`: `representation.modality`, `representation.kind`
- `action_bounds`: `data.action_low`, `data.action_high`
- `certificate`: `certificate.profile`, `certificate.reference_dynamics`, `generation.method`, `transition_model.kind`, `calibration.level`
- `calibration`: `calibration.level`, `certificate.profile`, `certificate.reference_dynamics`, `transition_model.fit_episodes`, `data.validation_fraction`, `generation.recovery_steps`
- `curate`: `curate.tolerance`, `curate.quantile`, `curate.population`, `certificate.profile`, `certificate.reference_dynamics`, `generation.evidence_mode`
